text: Performance follow-through: plan_geometry() is now the canonical lazy boundary; geometry(plan) is explicit full materialization; evaluate_geometry(plan, query) fuses fixed coordinates before spatial contraction. contrast(plan), rdm(plan), and rsa(plan) now use the query-fused path; contrast retains total, coherent, configuration, and signed marginals in one streamed source pass. Deep identity validation remains at plan/execution boundaries while trusted internal adapters and block reads avoid repeated recursive validation. Full package suite passes. Remaining Epic 4 gates: non-diagonal support-streamed schedule selection, static hot-buffer accounting, and redundant-route subtraction/benchmark decision.
